ability.name: Slippery Skumbag
ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, it can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

ability.name: Egomaniak
ability.effect:
While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly non-**^^Hero Kruleboyz^^** Infantry unit:
• This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**^^Hero Kruleboyz Infantry^^** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

ability.name: Backstabba
ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Add 1 to the mortal damage inflicted for each friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** unit in combat with the target in addition to the first two **^^Kruleboyz^^** units.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** in combat with both this unit and another friendly **^^Kruleboyz^^** unit to be the target.
